COLDCARD Desktop

Verify for yourself. Recover with confidence.

COLDCARD Desktop is the security companion for macOS and Windows — built for verification, not trust. Connect your device, audit seed risk, stage signed firmware, and migrate step by step. It never holds keys. It never signs transactions.

  • Seed Audit Engine — see if your seed was created under affected firmware, and whether dice rolls or a strong BIP-39 passphrase change the picture.
  • Migration Assistant — firmware update → new seed → backup check → on-device address confirm → test send → full move. Checkpoint at every stage.
  • Firmware integrity — download only signed images, verify SHA-256 and release signatures before anything touches your COLDCARD.
  • Host stays untrusted — no seed words, no passphrases, no private keys in software. Keys stay on the device.
Download for macOS Download for Windows Recovery Migration

macOS 12+ (Intel & Apple Silicon) · Windows 10/11 x64 · PGP-signed releases · Checksums published with every build

Before you install

Download only from this page. Compare the published SHA-256 before running the installer. Confirm receive addresses on the COLDCARD screen — never on the host. Keep the old backup until every transfer has confirmed on-chain.
